proof_components: Exact normalization q^-2; in the a=0 convolution fiber the coefficient is sum f(t)^2 rather than sum |f(t)|^2.
Gold derivative P(x+a)+P(x) = a^{2^k+1}[u^{2^k}+u+1] after x=au; kernel of u^{2^k}+u is GF(2^gcd(m,k)).
Three-term exact nonnegative deficit from triangle inequality, amplitude Cauchy and fiber Cauchy; equality characterization on all affine subfield lines.
Mixed trace-quadratic Boolean phases restrict to F2-affine functions along subfield lines since u and u^2 are F2-linear; nonzero mixed polar cross terms prove non-global-affinity.
correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the exact fourth-moment convolution from two output-character orthogonalities. For a≠0 the Gold derivative has linear kernel a*GF(2^gcd(m,k)), making each nonempty derivative fiber a size-s affine line. Fiber Cauchy–Schwarz, complex zero-fiber |sum f(x)^2|^2≤B^2, and amplitude variance establish (1+s−s/q)B^2, attained by f≡1. Independently expanded the three nonnegative deficit terms; equality forces flat nonzero |f|, one common squared phase (therefore scalar ±1 signs), and constant sign products on every derivative coset, equivalent to additive-F2 affinity on each affine GF(s) line. Checked d=1, d=m and 1<d<m branches, the explicit quadratic-trace nonlinear phases, projective counts at the endpoints, and the limits for all m,k≥1. A newly written independent GF(2^m) checker tested 10 parameter pairs (m≤6), 3 direct Walsh normalizations, 4 complex-vector exact deficit splits, nonlinear subfield examples and 48 random strict non-extremizer comparisons; finite evidence is corroboration only.

value.rationale: This is the natural sharp Fourier L2→L4 invariant of Gold polynomial graphs, a canonical nonlinear family in finite-field harmonic analysis and cryptographic differential uniformity. The all-gcd formula identifies the quantitative transition in maximal ordered-pair collisions, while for d>1 the full complex equality class is neither arbitrary phases nor simply additive characters: it is precisely Boolean functions affine on every proper subfield line, with genuine nonlinear quadratic-trace examples. The exact deficit separates three mathematically meaningful obstructions (phase-square, amplitude variance, fiber-product alignment). This is useful precise structure even without a general theorem downstream. The APN case is already known and credited; the motivation rests chiefly on the sharp non-APN regimes and the natural full family, not on recycled APN tables.
